verdict.rationale: Decagon's own integrations page says its integrations let the agent "handle escalations smoothly" across chat, email, and voice, so escalation itself is a documented capability. Nothing describes what the human receives at handoff. The cross-session history claims are about the AI agent keeping context, not about passing it to a human. missing for 10: documented transfer of the full transcript to the human agent, an auto-generated escalation summary, handoff of collected customer details/fields, evidence the customer doesn't repeat information, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, when the agent escalates, the human gets the full conversation, a summary, and collected details — the customer never repeats themselves

citations.quote: They ensure your agent can retrieve data, take action, and handle escalations smoothly across chat, email, and voice channels with no custom code required.
